name: Advanced Menu Condition
description: Condition plugins that show or hide blocks/layouts based on the active menu trail, with multi-select and child inheritance.
project_description: Advanced Menu Condition provides two Condition plugins that decide block (or any Condition-consuming) visibility from the active menu trail. 'Advanced menu position' (id advanced_menu_position) shows the block when one of the selected menu links is the active link or is an ancestor in the active trail, so a block can follow a menu branch and all of its children via inheritance. 'Advanced Menu position - Hide' (id advanced_menu_position_not) is the negation, hiding the block on those same trails. Both use a multi-select built from core's menu parent form selector, so an editor can pick several menu items across menus at once. Evaluation reads the active trail through core's menu.active_trail service (no user-supplied input). The module also ships a Drush command, advanced-menu-condition:cleanup (alias amc-cleanup), that scans all configuration and removes the module's dependency and visibility/condition entries; hook_uninstall() invokes it automatically so uninstalling does not leave dangling references. It is useful for block layout, Layout Builder and any plugin that consumes core Condition plugins, letting site builders target whole menu branches for contextual sidebars, banners or navigation without per-page path patterns.
